# CV-18 — Quiet hours, pausing and holds

> Branch `t/maciej/cv-18-quiet-holds-2` (from `t/maciej/cv-18-quiet-holds`, build head merged) · status: built, not landed
> Migration: `supabase/migrations/20261016210000_chat_v2_quiet_hours.sql` · applied to the local stack: yes, 2026-10-16, after CV-9, CV-13, CV-19 and CV-16 (every recut anchor matched the live bodies; nothing CV-16 redefines overlaps)

## Delivered against the row

- **Quiet hours in Time & region:** `user_preferences.quiet_hours_on / quiet_from / quiet_to` (a range in the person's zone that may cross midnight; a CHECK keeps "on" with a range), written only by `user_op_set_time_region` (key `quiet_hours` = `{on, from, to}`, "HH:MM"; turning on needs a range; from ≠ to; a range left out keeps the saved one), read by `user_time_region`; the guard keeps the columns op-only. All three redefined in place from their live bodies.
- **`time_region__quiet_now(user, at)` → (quiet, back_at)** in the saved zone (UTC when unknown or unreadable).
- **Pausing:** a table of its own, `user_notice_pauses(user_id, workspace_id, paused_at)`: each person reads only their own rows (RLS), nobody writes it directly; written only by `workspace_op_pause_notices(ws, paused)` for the caller (a member, or the workspace's owner even without a member row; API keys refused); read by `workspace_notice_pauses()` (the switcher), the gate and the email job. Leaving a workspace forgets its pause; erasing the person or the workspace removes the rows.
- **The gate's rules** (`notice__gate`): drop while paused, on do not disturb (CV-17's `hold` becomes `drop`, as the brief binds), or in quiet hours; hold chat kinds (not the summary) while a Focus run is running in its work phase and seen in the last 3 minutes, any workspace; else send. The break-through list is empty.
- **`BEFORE INSERT` trigger `notice_deliveries_gate`:** every device notice of every module asks the gate; drop writes nothing, hold marks the row `held_for_focus`. Tasks' reminders pass unchanged outside quiet hours.
- **Chat's switches, server-side** (CV-6b's deferral): `chat__notice_switch_on(user, reason)` reads `preferences.notifications.chatDirect | chatMentions | chatAnnouncements | chatEvery` (false = off). `chat__notify_devices` writes no notice for a switched-off reason.
- **`held_at`:** `chat__notify_devices` stamps the Catch up item of a message the gate drops or a switch keeps quiet. `chat__queue_waiting_emails` skips switched-off reasons, and while the person is paused, in quiet hours or on do not disturb it sends nothing and stamps what waits, so nothing emails when the hold ends.
- **Focus ends** (`focus_runs_release_held`, a run leaving `running`; a Pomodoro work phase ending in a break; starting the next Focus ends a run still running): that person's held rows are acknowledged and one `chat_focus_summary` ("3 messages while you focused", url `/chat?view=catchup`) goes through the gate (`focus__release_held`), in the workspace of the latest released message whose workspace isn't paused, else the run's. A running run deleted (an erasure cascade) closes its held rows without a summary. The whole trigger body is guarded: any failure is a warning and Focus still ends.
- **A Focus that never ended** (the app closed, a release that failed): `focus_runs__release_stale(now)`, cron `focus-release-stale-holds` every 5 minutes, releases the held rows (with the summary, in the latest run's workspace) of anyone with no running run seen in the last 10 minutes, so "N held until Focus ends" clears within 15 minutes. Its summary has its own tag, `chat:focus:<latest run>:stale`, so it never replaces (or is counted as) that run's own summary on a device. A partial index `notice_deliveries_held_open (user_id) WHERE held_for_focus AND acked_at IS NULL` serves the release and the sweep. A run swept twice replaces its `:stale` summary by tag on a device.
- **The summary opens Catch up:** on desktop, Moduo coming to the front after the summary rang lands on `/chat?view=catchup` (`chatNoticeTarget` reads the Catch up link; it read only conversation links before).
- **`chat_now`:** `quiet_now`, `back_at`; people in quiet hours are listed.
- **Status changes limited** (CV-17's deferral): 30 sets or clears in 10 minutes (`user_status_changes`, private), `PT429` past it.
- **App:** Time & region model/patch carry `quietHours` (+ `isQuietNow`, pure, as the server reads it); Settings → Preferences → Quiet hours (switch + range, `TimeInput`); the workspace switcher's bell button per workspace (pause/resume, `bell-off` when paused); "Sofia's quiet hours · back 9:00" on the line above the box (`composerHoldLine` → `quietHoursLine`); "3 held until Focus ends" above Catch up's list; Settings' Chat switches now say they turn off notifications and emails.

## Agent's choices (agent's choice, deferred — confirmed for building, revisitable)

Each: who · what · why · rejected alternative. The pause table is the superseding decision **CV18-0** in `docs/decisions/chat.md` (indexed in `docs/decisions.md`, added at checkpoint 4).

- **A Focus summary that arrives while the gate drops is dropped** (quiet hours, do not disturb, or the run's workspace paused at release) · agent · the summary is a ping like any other and those rules mean "nothing rings"; the holds still close and every message waits in Catch up, so nothing is lost · rejected: letting `chat_focus_summary` skip the pause / quiet rules (a summary would ring at 23:00 or from a paused workspace).
- **The stale sweep's summary is tagged `chat:focus:<run>:stale`** · agent · a device replaces a notice by tag; the sweep must not overwrite or be mistaken for the run's own summary · rejected: reusing `chat:focus:<run>`.

- **Pauses live in their own table, `user_notice_pauses`** · agent (orchestrator's call during review) · a person's pause is theirs alone: rows only they read, written only by the op, read by the op, the switcher's read and the gate · rejected: a `notices_paused_at` column on `workspace_members` (spec round-3 §2.12), because members read each other's membership rows.
- **Pausing Focus counts as ending it** (the run leaving `running` writes the summary) · agent · a paused Focus no longer holds pings, so what it held is released together · rejected: holding through a pause until the run ends.
- **New messages ring during Pomodoro breaks, and a break releases what the work phase held** (one summary per break, tag `chat:focus:<run>`, so a device shows the latest) · agent (after code review) · the hold reads the work phase only (the same test as "Focusing" in `chat_now`; a device unseen for 3 minutes doesn't hold), and holding the older pings while newer ones ring would deliver them out of order · rejected: any running run holds (breaks would stay silent), keeping the work phase's holds until the run ends.
- **The email job stamps items from before quiet hours, so they're never emailed** · agent · "nothing pings at 9:00" (AC3.5) includes the email; while the gate drops, what waits is held for good · rejected: emailing a backlog when quiet hours end.
- **Do not disturb drops pings instead of holding them** · agent · the brief binds drop for dnd; a held row is only released by a Focus end · rejected: keeping CV-17's hold.
- **A Focus that never ended is released after 10 minutes unseen** (job every 5 minutes, with the summary; plus the next Focus start, which ends a run still running) · agent · a closed app must not keep rows held or "N held" showing; 10 minutes rides out a sleeping laptop that the gate's 3 minutes wouldn't · rejected: release only at the next Focus start (could be days), releasing silently without the summary.
- **An owner without a member row can pause** · agent · the owner hears the workspace's notices; the op checks owner or member · rejected: members only.
- **Switches stamp `held_at` too** · agent · a message whose switch was off never emails, even if the switch is turned back on later · rejected: reading the switch only when the email goes.
- **One summary per release, in the workspace of the latest released message that isn't paused (else the run's)**, counting distinct messages still readable and not deleted · agent (orchestrator's call after validator round 2) · the click lands on the Catch up that holds them, and a paused workspace never silences another's messages (AC6.4) · rejected: one per workspace (several summaries for one Focus), always the run's workspace (a pause there dropped a client's summary).
- **The previous run's summary rings when the next Focus starts** · agent (orchestrator's call) · starting Focus ends a run still running, and summaries are exempt from holds, so its summary rings even though a new Focus has begun; it's one notice about the past run, and holding it would need a second release · rejected: holding that summary under the new run.
- **Quiet hours live in Settings → Preferences (its Notifications part), not in Time & region** · agent · spec §15 puts them under Notifications; times follow the Time & region zone, named in the group's line · rejected: a second copy in Time & region.
- **Pause is a bell button on each switcher row** (tooltip "Pause notifications from this workspace"; filled `bell-off` while paused) · agent · no frame draws it; the row already has icon buttons (settings, delete) · rejected: a menu item per workspace (the switcher has no per-row menu).
- **"3 held until Focus ends" shows above Catch up's list** (own rows, read every 30 s) · agent · Catch up is where the items wait · rejected: the Focus timer (Tasks' surface).
- **"Back 9:00" is on the reader's clock**; do not disturb's line wins over quiet hours' · agent.
- **Status limit 30 changes / 10 minutes** · agent · each change reaches every teammate live · rejected: a per-minute limit (presets clicked in a row).
- **`chat_reminder` and the summary pass the switches untouched** · agent · you asked for a reminder; the summary is the hold's own notice.

- **Rows CV-17 held for do not disturb close quietly when this migration runs** (anyone not focusing right then) · agent (after code review) · do not disturb drops from here on, and the stale sweep would otherwise ring them as "N messages while you focused"; the items stay in Catch up · rejected: letting the sweep release them with a summary.
- **Turning quiet hours on with no saved zone saves the zone the row names** · agent (after code review) · the server reads the saved zone (UTC when none), the row names the resolved one; sign-in normally saves it already · rejected: naming UTC in the row.

## Gotchas (area: supabase)

- **Deploy note:** the partial index `notice_deliveries_held_open` is built without `CONCURRENTLY` (migrations run in one transaction); fine at today's `notice_deliveries` size, but it briefly locks writes to that table on prod.

- A check in the same statement as a volatile call doesn't see its writes (`test.ok(f() >= 1 AND NOT EXISTS (…))` reads the snapshot from before `f` ran): call it first, then check.
- Rows inserted in one transaction share `now()`: tests that order runs by `started_at` set them apart by hand.

- `test.try` runs its SQL and then rolls it back (it's for refusals): writes a later check depends on must use `test.as_user`.
- `pg_temp.recut` edits one at a time: each step must compile on its own (a select list using a join added by a later step fails).

## Open designer questions

- ❓ **`back_at` lets teammates roughly infer someone's time zone.** "Sofia's quiet hours · back 9:00" is shown in the reader's own clock, so the end of someone's quiet hours hints at where they live. Built as specced; keep it, coarsen it (e.g. "back in the morning"), or hide the time?

## For later blocks

- **Checkpoint / later polish (code review, not needed for this block):** `notice__gate` runs up to three times per recipient per message (the held_at stamp, the insert's filter and the trigger), and `time_region__quiet_now`'s zone check opens a subtransaction; fine at workspace sizes, worth one CTE when channels grow. Catch up's "N held" polls every 30 s even without a Focus (gate it on the local run store). `isQuietNow` (`src/lib/time-region.ts`) has no production caller yet; it mirrors the server rule for tests.
- **Checkpoint / CV-23:** a component test of `NoticeDeliveries`' focus-to-land path (summary rang in the background → window focus → `/chat?view=catchup`) needs mocks for the realtime channel, `useWorkspace` and Tauri; the pure link is covered by `ring.test.ts`.

- **CV-23:** `chat__reopen` still keeps `later_until` (CV-11's open item) and the header count still includes quiet lines; not touched here.
- **CV-21:** a key's own switch: add its reason to `chat__notice_switch_on` (the email job and devices read it there).
- **CV-22 / export:** `user_status_changes` is a rate counter, not personal content (cascades from profiles); quiet hours ride in `user_time_region`; `user_notice_pauses` (person, workspace, paused_at) belongs in a person's export and cascades from profiles and workspaces (both covered in `chat_erasure.test.sql`).
- **Bell excerpt dates** (CV-11's open item) not touched.
- Any module that wants a kind to break through quiet hours adds it to the gate's list (`p_kind = ANY ('{}')`).

## Manual checklist (step → expect → surface)

- [ ] Settings → Preferences → Quiet hours on, 19:00 → 9:00 → saved; reload keeps it; a second device shows it → web
- [ ] In quiet hours, a teammate DMs you → no notification on desktop or browser; it's in Catch up; no email later → desktop + web
- [ ] Teammate opens your DM during your quiet hours → "Sofia's quiet hours · back 9:00" above the box → web
- [ ] A Tasks reminder during quiet hours → in the bell, no push; outside quiet hours → push as before → web
- [ ] Workspace switcher → bell on a client workspace → paused (bell-off); its messages don't ring, the other workspace's do; counts still fill → desktop
- [ ] Start Focus, get a DM and an @mention → no ring; Catch up shows "2 held until Focus ends"; end Focus → one "2 messages while you focused" → desktop
- [ ] Focus with a held DM, end it with Moduo in the background → "1 message while you focused" rings; bring Moduo to the front → Catch up opens → desktop
- [ ] Start Focus, get a DM, quit the app → within 15 minutes the summary arrives on another device and "held until Focus ends" is gone → desktop + web
- [ ] Settings → Chat → Direct messages off → a DM rings nowhere and never emails → web
- [ ] Set your status many times quickly → after 30 in 10 minutes, "You're changing your status too often" → web
